fields.why: Table 2 gives adjusted multinomial ORs for each level of age (7), race/ethnicity (5), education (3) and income (4) against a referent, with significance marks.
Age, race/ethnicity and SES (education, income) have 3+ levels; sex and metro status have 2, census region is geography, and household hearing impairment is not framed as social position.
Every SPD level is assessed only by an OR and p<0.05 mark against its 'Referent' row; no joint Wald or omnibus test is reported.
